name: Ishida Mizuki
source:
A college girl who lives next door to the protagonist; their windows face each other. They’re on friendly terms, they say hello when they run into each other.

She’s the slightly pushy, overprotective “little sister” type, but when she lets loose, she’s quite slutty; it feels like she’s using her rationality to suppress a sex drive that’s stronger than most.

She’s in the same year as the protagonist and also works part-time at a café on campus.

She’s actually a heavy masturbator. It seems she was inspired to try exhibitionism after peeking in on the protagonist having sex with his window open next door and thinking, “I want to expose myself too.”

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/227185/]Getchu[/url]]
